tweetText: Day two of TechEx North America focused on the challenges and future of enterprise AI, emphasizing the issue of projects failing after initial success. Understanding these roadblocks is crucial for advancing AI adoption in businesses. via AI News.

Nvidia's H200 chip deal with China remains stalled despite high-level talks between Trump and Xi. This reflects ongoing tensions in US-China trade and highlights the challenges in semiconductor exports. via AI News.

OpenAI has launched a multi-year AI partnership in Singapore to boost local talent and enhance services for businesses and the public. This initiative highlights the growing importance of AI in improving societal and economic outcomes. via OpenAI News

OpenAI has launched new tools like Content Credentials and SynthID to improve the trustworthiness of AI-generated media. This initiative aims to create a safer and more transparent AI ecosystem. via OpenAI News

Google unveiled its new AI design app at IO 2026, aimed at making design accessible for everyone, including teachers and small business owners. This move could democratize design tools and empower a wider audience. via TechCrunch AI
Google's new AI feature for Gmail lets users talk to their inbox and ask Gemini to find hidden emails. This makes managing emails easier and more efficient. via TechCrunch AI

Google is introducing AI-powered “information agents” that can keep track of topics and notify users about updates. This innovation aims to enhance search experiences by providing timely and relevant information. via TechCrunch AI.

A teen hacker turned Iron Dome researcher has raised $28M for Ocean, an AI email security platform that detects phishing by analyzing the context of emails. This innovation could significantly improve online safety against fraud. via TechCrunch AI

Elon Musk's lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft was quickly dismissed by a jury, revealing the case lacked strength. This matters as it highlights Musk's delayed legal action and questions his claims about the non-profit. via TechCrunch AI

Google has unveiled new "audio glasses" that let users control apps with voice commands. This move highlights the growing trend of integrating AI into everyday devices, enhancing user experience. via TechCrunch AI
